summary: Avoid worktree lease processes for unchanged render output

schema.detail: No SQLite schema, index or client schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Render passes still plan all members and union shared Git excludes. Only members needing output or legacy cleanup acquire deletion admission; unchanged plans publish receipts without committing. Mutating members revalidate their workspace and reprepare output under the lease; a changed plan is deferred rather than applied with stale graph decisions. Normalized worktree identities survive through start admission and are stored in existing local start-operation JSON bodies, including bare repositories nested inside parent worktrees. Recovery refuses records with missing admission data or a missing/replaced workspace, while allowing durable operation retirement and a fresh start on a later pass. Retiring an old-format queued explicit restart reissues its still-current restart authority with a fresh request and admission, transferring any retained idle/quiescent boundary before retiring the original request; obsolete lifecycle intent is not reissued. Declared checkouts are revalidated at every start boundary, including retained leases. No start recreates a checkout as a plain directory. Legacy-cleanup inspection failures fail closed.

recovery.detail: No data migration; binary rollback remains available.
